name: Jitender Tyre Shop Manager
author: jitenderkr

sections.description:
Jitender Tyre Shop Manager is a powerful, free foundation for tyre shops, garage owners, and automotive dealerships. It seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce to provide professional vehicle-to-tyre matching, appointment booking, and dealership management.

Free Features:
* Vehicle Database: Comprehensive database for accurate tyre fitment.
* Fitment Engine: Smart matching of tyres to specific vehicle makes, models, and years.
* Garage Booking System: Allow customers to book service appointments directly from your website.
* Dealer Management: Manage your dealership profile and locations.
* EMI Calculator: Display simple monthly installment estimates on product pages.

Note: Advanced features like Multi-Location Fleet Management, OpenAI-powered Tyre Recommendations, Automated WhatsApp CRM, and Bank-Integrated Financing are available in JTS Pro.

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to third-party services (WhatsApp Business API and OpenAI) only if you explicitly configure and enable them in the plugin settings with your own API keys. No customer data is sent to any third party by default.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jitender-tyre-shop-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘JTS’ in your WordPress admin dashboard to configure settings.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated for full functionality.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, Jitender Tyre Shop Manager is designed to extend WooCommerce. Please ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.

Can I manage multiple garage locations?

The free version supports basic location management. For advanced multi-location fleet and dealer management, please upgrade to JTS Pro.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added vehicle database and fitment engine.
  • Added garage booking and basic dealer management.
  • Added EMI calculator display for WooCommerce products.
